scope.goal: Test whether the newly explicit X(8) sign/character labels close the pointwise anti-isometry ambiguity left by EX1-05AC and thereby identify delta_0inf with one retained residue.

single_sign_fixed_branch_pairs.s_u0: u0=0 iff t in {0,infinity}, hence Z3
single_sign_fixed_branch_pairs.s_v0: v0=0 iff t in {+1,-1}, hence Z1
single_sign_fixed_branch_pairs.s_w0: w0=0 iff t in {+i,-i}, hence Z2

marked_odd_lift_identification.reason: Among the four odd sign changes, the three single signs are the unique elements with fixed points over the three marked branch-pair blocks; the triple sign is fixed-point-free.

named_prym_character_adapter.result: The three Prym factors are now source-bound to the three NAMED ABSTRACT W classes: E_su<->delta_0inf, E_sv<->delta_pm1, E_sw<->delta_pmi.

why_H_equivariance_does_not_finish_absol.character_action: On a Prym character elliptic factor, h in H acts as scalar +/-1 according to the character.
why_H_equivariance_does_not_finish_absol.two_torsion_collapse: On E[2], -P=P, so +1 and -1 induce the same action.
why_H_equivariance_does_not_finish_absol.consequence: H acts trivially on the factor 2-torsion labels used by K(P,Xi), so an H-equivariant gluing anti-isometry is not forced to send a named invariant-side center to the same named character factor.
why_H_equivariance_does_not_finish_absol.compatibility_with_EX1_05AC: 05AC closes the center planes setwise and gives a unique Bolza-equivariant orbit alignment, but explicitly leaves named deck-character orientation behind a separate adapter.

prym_mod2_action_exhaustion.input_from_05AB: All three selected xi are the unique Gaussian-CM-fixed nonzero points on their j=1728 factors.

gaussian_unit_flexibility.principle: Multiplication by i preserves the Gaussian norm and swaps identity-type versus i-type mod-2 action.

prym_mod2_action_exhaustion.required_for_invariant_side: Each retained residue acts on A[2] as rank-one symplectic transvection, so a compatible Prym action uses exactly one i-type factor.
prym_mod2_action_exhaustion.consequence: The named degree data 137,9,9 do not select which factor carries the transvection; all three retained residue centers remain compatible.

integration_with_absolute_W_problem.remaining_pointwise_gap: Need the actual fixed complementary-polarization anti-isometry psi:A[2]->K(P,Xi) on one NAMED center, or equivalent integral period/homology data. Setwise plane alignment and H-equivariance are insufficient.
integration_with_absolute_W_problem.if_named_pointwise_anchor_for_E_su_is_ob: The image/preimage of the E_su center would identify delta_0inf with exactly one of centers/residues 73,97,235.
integration_with_absolute_W_problem.relation_to_KRR_no_go: This is the internal X(8)/Prym analogue of the external KRR right-G48 torsor obstruction: both fail at a missing marked pointwise orientation, not at group-conjugacy or setwise compatibility.
